compute.sign: (() => { const t = input.pre.tok; const st = (t && t.data && t.data.stoken) || ''; return { url: 'https://drive-h.quark.cn/1/clouddrive/share/sharepage/detail?pr=ucpro&fr=pc&uc_param_str=&ver=2&pwd_id=' + encodeURIComponent(input.params.pwd_id) + '&stoken=' + encodeURIComponent(st) + '&pdir_fid=0&force=0&_page=1&_size=50&_fetch_total=1&_sort=file_type:asc,file_name:asc' }; })()
compute.decode: (() => { const t = input.pre.tok; if (!t || typeof t.code !== 'number') throw new Error('quark token: unreadable body'); if (t.code !== 0) { const s = t.status; if (typeof s === 'number' && s >= 400 && s < 500 && s !== 429) return { validity: 'not-usable', files: [], reason: String(t.message || ('code ' + t.code)) }; throw new Error('quark token status ' + s + ' code ' + t.code + ': ' + (t.message || '?')); } if (!t.data || !t.data.stoken) throw new Error('quark token: code 0 without stoken'); const b = input.body; const list = (b && b.data && b.data.list) || []; const files = list.map((f) => ({ name: String(f.file_name || ''), is_dir: !!f.dir, size: Number(f.size || 0) })); return files.length ? { validity: 'alive', files: files } : { validity: 'not-usable', files: [], reason: '分享里没有文件' }; })()
